Class SocketClientHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.network.socket.server.SocketClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualView, Remote
public class SocketClientHandler extends Object implements VirtualView
The SocketClientHandler class is a server-side component responsible for managing the communication with a single connected client in a socket-based network environment. It implements the VirtualView interface, which means it acts as a listener for the server, allowing the server's core logic to send updates and commands to a specific client as if it were directly interacting with the client's view.

  • Method Details

    • run

      public void run() throws IOException, ClassNotFoundException
      The main execution loop for this client handler. It continuously reads ClientServerCommand objects from the client's input stream. Each received command is then executed on the SocketServer. If an exception occurs during command execution, an ExceptionCommand is sent back to the client.
      Throws:
      IOException - If an I/O error occurs while reading objects, or if other unexpected errors occur.
      ClassNotFoundException - If the class of the object to deserialize can't be found.
